works.body:
Hello! I saw a lot of your art on pixiv, and think you're incredibly talented at drawing mecha girls!

I was wondering if you could draw Celia for me, and she is 23.
I am moving away from her cat ear design to look more like a robot or android. 

Description:
She has dirty blonde hair and curvy figure, and stands at 178 cm tall.
She has dark blue eyes and fair skin. 
She is incredibly kind to those around her and enjoys relaxing. 
She is toned, with a bit of muscle.
Her eyes hold a softness to them when looking at others.
She likes to hold soft grins / smiles. 

I would like her to have white and black robotic limbs. Specifically, her neck and arms. 
For her clothing, a modern dress that shows off her arms and chest slightly.
Her hair should be long and wavy, down to her waist.
I wanted her to be drinking hot cocoa from a mug! Near a fireplace!
Her pose is up to you, as is the composition. I trust your artistic talent!

I wish you luck!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CjzHqksHyOFxOuaDzKkdJ6SaiWC3AHiL?usp=drive_link

I am here from X. If you don't mind, I would like to ask you to illustrate my original character here.
*Severe appearance of checking equipment, data, etc. in a dimly lit maintenance room.
*Slightly battered appearance with helmet (headgear) removed and dreadlocks that seem to be tied together with wires. He is wearing bandages.
Basically, you can draw it however you want.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1P3ow-nltmG70-rp9kHPX00_axTGNvAWs?usp=drive_link

Nice to meet you.
I am very interested in your illustration of my child.
I would love to have an illustration of my child.

I would love to have an illustration of my child.
I love your illustrations of mecha girls and droid police.
If possible, we would like to have an illustration of our child in the same direction, but with mechagirl-like equipment.
I would like her to be lively and energetic.

She used to be from a fantasy world, but now she travels freely in various worlds.
The costume and equipment are also changed according to the world and situation, and the outfit we are asking for this time is based on the image of a cyber and sci-fi world (different from the original world).
We would very much like to have the armament and equipment of your choice.
Either equipment that matches the fighting style of the character setting described below or new equipment is welcome.
We would appreciate it if you could draw it in a good way.
Pose and composition are also up to you as well.

We are happy to see attractive limbs in good attire.

My child.
Her name is Tico.
She is a brown girl of about 17 years of age.
She has a beautiful and cute image.
Her personality is cheerful, kind, and generous. She is innocent, but mature enough not to be out of touch with the world.
She is relatively serious, but can be mischievous with people she is close to.
She enjoys housework, cooking, and gardening. She loves fruits (especially citrus fruits), bathing and taking hot baths.
She is very caring and likes children and taking care of them.
Height 155cm

Slightly large, bright purple eyes.
Blonde hair that almost reaches her back.
Brown skin with a very nice luster.
She has large breasts, but they are not sagging and have a good shape and firmness.
Her stomach and thighs are also firm.

She has a strong life force and healing power, which she usually uses for her travels and for the people she travels with.
By applying her abilities, she can create thorny claws and fast-growing thorns, and she can amplify healing and put up barriers with her butterfly shield.
His physical ability is high, and his original fighting style is more of a melee fighting style, mainly using kicking techniques and claws, and using a butterfly shield as a supplement.
When close range is difficult, she can send out sharply pointed barriers of light or extend thorns.

Hi, could you draw my character Rita? She is a courier in a futuristic city. Rita's left arm is a robotic prosthetic. Please draw Rita repairing her own arm. You can draw the arm with the synthetic skin removed, showing the metal parts. Any other detail is up to you.
